visado.aprobacion.aprobarBloqueado: The exact operation details are missing.
visado.aprobacion.motivoRotulo: {persona} wrote this. It explains the request and is not part of the operation.
visado.aprobacion.sinDetalle: The exact operation couldn't be determined. Do not approve this request.
visado.error.autoaprobacion: You can't approve your own request.
visado.error.estadoInvalido: This request has already been decided or its status has changed.
visado.error.huellaNoCoincide: The request has changed since you opened it. Close it and open it again.
visado.error.opcionDesaparecida: The selected item no longer exists. Submit a new request.
visado.error.sinAutoridad: You don't have permission to run this operation.
visado.help.actions.approve.v: Authorizes one run of the exact operation shown.
visado.help.actions.cancel.v: Closes the form or withdraws a request, depending on where it appears.
visado.help.actions.open.v: Opens the details so you can review the method, path, body, arguments, warnings, and explanation before deciding.
visado.help.actions.reject.v: Denies the request; you can provide an optional reason.
visado.help.actions.request.v: Sends the selected operation, its data, and your explanation to the owner.
visado.help.actions.title: Buttons and actions
visado.help.actions.tokens: No action in this panel consumes tokens. It is deterministic from end to end: the catalog is code, validation is code, and operations use a runner without AI.
visado.help.first.step1: From a room, choose an operation from the list.
visado.help.first.step2: Choose its data: always from a list, never by typing it in.
visado.help.first.step3: Explain why you are requesting it.
visado.help.first.step4: Wait: the owner receives the request and decides.
visado.help.first.title: First steps
visado.help.icons.check.desc: submits a request or approves an operation
visado.help.icons.check.name: Confirm
visado.help.icons.close.name: Reject
visado.help.icons.closed.name: Collapsed panel
visado.help.icons.help.name: Help
visado.help.icons.loading.desc: the operation catalog is being prepared
visado.help.icons.loading.name: Loading
visado.help.icons.open.name: Expanded panel
visado.help.icons.title: Icon legend
visado.help.indexBlurb: Operation requests, exact review, and owner approval.
visado.help.intro: Approvals is a channel for requesting operations. If a guest in a room needs an operation on the host's infrastructure, they do not run it: they request it. The owner sees exactly what will run and decides.
visado.help.states.cancelled: the request was withdrawn before it ran
visado.help.states.failed: the operation ended with an error
visado.help.states.rejected: the owner decided not to authorize it
visado.help.states.title: Statuses
visado.help.title: Approvals
visado.help.warning.expiry: An unanswered request expires after 24 hours and runs nothing. Silence never means approval.
visado.help.warning.once: An approval is valid for one run only. If you need it again, submit a new request.
visado.help.warning.self: No one can approve their own request, even an administrator.
visado.help.warning.title: Keep in mind
visado.help.what.capability.v: What you can do on your own, without someone else's permission.
visado.help.what.note: Tightening permissions without a request channel leaves a guest unable to do something or request it. Approvals is that second half: it keeps the boundary in place and provides a controlled way to ask.
visado.help.what.request.v: What you cannot run on your own but can ask the owner to review and authorize.
visado.help.what.title: Capability vs. request
visado.peticion.motivoNota: The approver reads this; it is not part of the operation.
visado.peticion.nadaDisponible: There are no operations available to request right now.
visado.peticion.operacionNoDisponible: {operacion} — can't be requested right now: no options are available
visado.peticion.parametroFaltante: Choose an option for every parameter.
visado.peticion.sinParametros: This operation has no parameters to choose.
visado.rechazo.nota: You can provide a reason; it is optional.
